verdict.rationale: The probe found no llms.txt (HTTP 404). The closest first-party agent-oriented material is the bundled agent skills, which give an agent guidance for making apps, plugins, and themes; the omarchy CLI is pitched as agent-friendly, but a CLI is not documentation. missing for 10: a published llms.txt, dedicated agent-oriented docs covering the system broadly, evidence of the skills' depth or content, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Omarchy ships with skills to help your agent make apps, plugins, and themes.
